args.body: For the existing catalogue pilot, reconcile the item 4 release binding and operator decision pointer against any newer permitted redacted decision or send receipt. Reuse any completed reconciliation. If an authorized send is recorded, establish what permitted evidence can track the result from that send date. If a decline is recorded, preserve it and close only the dependent referral route under valid ownership if its mission permits. If no decision can be verified, keep the existing decision blocker and do not request authorization again. Keep eligible inbound requests, delivery, accepted orders and Treasury settlement separate. Use no private correspondence and make no external contact.
